thread:
jess (AE): Kicking off MedSure POC thread. Need to finalize which user journeys we demo, the API endpoints to expose, and measurable success criteria. Can we target a 5-week trial?

dan (SalesEng): 5 weeks sounds doable. Which journeys are mandatory versus nice-to-have?

jess (AE): Their shortlist from the kickoff: 1) Live agent reply suggestions for care coordinators 2) Automated clinical note summarization 3) Find similar prior cases for clinician reference. They asked for a low-latency demo first.

priya (CSE): My recommended order: Agent-assist (streaming), Embeddings-driven retrieval, then batched summarization. We should show A/B between fast-quantized vs high-qual model.

raj (MedSure Eng): Confirm: we need streaming; also want an example of tool-calling to hit our Triage API. Can you show an example request?

dan (SalesEng): Sure, example minimal payload:

```
POST /v1/redwood/generate
Authorization: Bearer <KEY>
Body: {
  "model": "redwood-2.1",
  "stream": true,
  "tools": ["triage_api"],
  "prompt": "Patient: dizziness + migraine. Suggest triage steps (<=2 sentences). Flag emergency conditions."
}
```

priya (CSE): Suggested endpoints for the deck: `/v1/generate` for streaming chat, `/v1/embeddings` for similarity, `/v1/batch/summarize` for bulk notes. Add headers and example latency targets.

jess (AE): Procurement asked for pricing options: short hosted pilot vs isolated dedicated trial. They want cost predictability.

dan (SalesEng): Recommend: hosted trial with a $1,500 monthly usage cap + optional 3-week Dedicated sandbox at $5k flat for quick isolation. Include clause: overage triggers a pause and notification.

sec-bot: MedSure security form: https://redwood.app/security/medsure-oq — status: 8/28 answered. Please @priya for tech questions.

priya (CSE): I'll pick up the technical questionnaire items. Note: data residency: they want logs off by default and all patient data pinned to us-west-2. We can provision region pinning or Private control plane.

raj (MedSure Eng): We also need encryption-in-transit + at-rest certs and an SSO flow (SAML). Also SOC2 evidence and a simple IR process.

priya (CSE): All standard. I'll upload SSO runbook and SOC2 artifact links. For IR, we'll provide an incident playbook template.

jess (AE): Success metrics we should nail to close: 
- p95 generation latency < 300ms (streaming)
- Hallucination rate < 4% on clinical QA set
- Embedding recall@10 > 85% on retrieval tasks
- Demonstrable cost per session < $0.12

dan (SalesEng): Agree. For the eval set, ask MedSure to provide 40 real support transcripts (anonymized) + 20 clinical summaries as ground truth.

raj (MedSure Eng): We'll deliver an anonymized eval pack by Tue EOD. Also confirm whether you support per-route rate limits and token-level cost breakdowns.

priya (CSE): We support per-route quotas and token cost breakdown in the Console. We'll include a screenshot in the handoff doc.

infra-bot: Note: Dedicated sandbox requires GPU SKU request; typical provisioning time = 4 business days after approval.

jess (AE): Proposed timeline: Week 0: contract + security Qs done; Week 1: infra & sample ingestion; Weeks 2-3: live pilot with 1-2 agents; Week 4: run formal evals + cost analysis; Week 5: wrap and decision.

dan (SalesEng): Action items: 
- @dan: pricing sheet + MSA addendum draft by Fri
- @priya: finish security Qs + SSO runbook by Mon
- @raj: upload anonymized eval pack by Tue
- @jess: finalize demo plan and agent scripts by Wed

priya (CSE): For evals we'll run: 25 live-turn prompts + 15 summarization cases. We'll A/B test and compute delta in hallucination and latency. Pass criteria: faster model within 90% of quality and >25% lower token cost.

raj (MedSure Eng): We'll stream token output from the UI. Also we need to see an example fallback policy for the canary (auto-fallback to conservative model on hallucination spike).

priya (CSE): We'll propose rollout: 5% canary -> monitor hallucination metric -> if spike > threshold, auto-rollback and route to conservative model. Will attach runbook.

jess (AE): Good. Let's reconvene Thursday 10am PT to sign off on pricing + security. Thanks all! :white_check_mark:
